kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستقيئ (form X)
# نَسْتَقْيِئُ (nastaqyiʔu) /nas.taq.ji.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْيَأَ (istaqyaʔa)
# نَسْتَقْيِئَ (nastaqyiʔa) /nas.taq.ji.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْيَأَ (istaqyaʔa)
# نَسْتَقْيِئْ (nastaqyiʔ) /nas.taq.jiʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَقْيَأَ (istaqyaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
